name_reason: Compliant with convention data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: 'data_fd2_battle_' marks a battle-core runtime-state global, and 'current_active_char_idx' accurately names the value (the party-slot index the turn cursor advances from, an unsigned index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr). The descriptor reflects the data type (a scalar index). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Runtime battle-state scalar holding the party-slot index that the turn cursor advances from (the starting slot for the 'next actor' search).
logic_summary: Zero-initialized BSS (.object2). The engine always writes it before reading. fd2_load_save_and_init_engine sets it to 0 at the end of a LOAD GAME; fd2_run_full_turn_cycle sets it to 0 when a new player turn begins; fd2_game_main_loop's 'next actor' path (ESC/scancodes 0x01/0x2C/0x4C) reads it as the starting slot, then writes back slot+1, wrapping to 0 when it reaches data_fd2_battle_party_member_count. Accessed as a full dword and used as an unsigned index into the runtime character array.
element_semantics: Single uint32 scalar; an unsigned party-slot index (0..party_member_count-1) into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (80-byte runtime_char stride). Not a table/array.
